[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 1: Cardio Blast - Warm-up: 5 minutes on treadmill or stationary bike, HIIT: 20 minutes (30 seconds intense + 30 seconds rest), Cool-down: 5 minutes stretching.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 2: Strength Training Circuit - Warm-up: 5 minutes light cardio, Circuit of 6-8 exercises (3 sets of 10-12 reps each): Squats, Lunges, Chest press, Lat pulldowns, Bicep curls, Tricep dips, Plank, Cool-down: 5 minutes stretching.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 3: Full-Body Workout - Warm-up: 5 minutes light cardio, Exercises in sequence with 30-60 seconds rest: Burpees, Mountain climbers, Dumbbell rows, Jump squats, Plank jacks, Bicycle crunches, Cool-down: 5 minutes stretching.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 4: Quick HIT - Warm-up: 5 minutes light cardio, Choose 3-4 exercises (3 sets of 10-12 reps each), Finish with 2-3 minutes all-out effort on treadmill or stationary bike, Cool-down: 5 minutes stretching.
